summary: Plan completed and committed (AnsibleSpecs 4c45818). It has five phases: the JenkinsPipelineUtils CPS-compile gate, an iac-toolchain container template, the ArgoCDTools test stage before publishing, the PrometheusDeploy promtool check plus unit tests, and the argo-cd D61 correction as its own phase. verification.json has 14 criteria mapped to R1–R3, with R4 recorded as split to slice 030. Two Outstanding actions are in the close-out: the pre-run toolchain push and restart, and a push hazard if slice 028 runs first.
